title: Introduce step-up authentication validation for high value payments
executive_summary: ECR-2026-004 (Introduce step-up authentication validation for high value payments) is a mixed change in the Security domain, scored 79/100 (CRITICAL). It touches REQ-1001 (Card Payment Authorization), REQ-1017 (Multi-Factor Authentication), REQ-1018 (Session Token Lifecycle). History is relevant here: BUG-180 (Fraud score computed on pre-conversion amount), BUG-201 (Payment validation allowed invalid currency codes), BUG-281 (Validator rejected valid amounts above 10,000). Decisions already recorded: Decision: UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY must be raised before funds are reserved, not after. Confirmed with treasury that no reservation may exist for a rejected currency. Open concern: BUG-201 was reopened twice because the fix only checked code length. Please add the ISO-4217 catalogue assertion to the regression pack, not just the merchant list check. Recommended regression: 73 of 150 tests (51.3% reduction), 0 P0 and 16 P1. Evidence is missing for: REQ-1001, REQ-1002, REQ-1004, REQ-1006.

ecr_overview.title: Introduce step-up authentication validation for high value payments
ecr_overview.description: Introduce a new authentication validation step: payments above the configured high-value threshold must present a fresh multi-factor authentication assertion. The auth service issues a step-up token and the payment service validates the assertion before authorisation.

matched_requirements.title: Card Payment Authorization
matched_requirements.description: The Payment Service shall authorise card payments against the acquirer, capture an authorisation code and persist the transaction with its currency, amount and merchant reference.
matched_requirements.reason: Explicitly linked to the ECR in the change record.

matched_requirements.title: Multi-Factor Authentication
matched_requirements.description: Sign-in from an unrecognised device and any high-value payment shall require a second authentication factor before the action completes.
matched_requirements.reason: Explicitly linked to the ECR in the change record.

matched_requirements.title: Session Token Lifecycle
matched_requirements.description: Access tokens shall expire after 30 minutes of inactivity, be renewable with a refresh token and be revoked immediately on password change.
matched_requirements.reason: Explicitly linked to the ECR in the change record.

matched_requirements.title: Fraud Screening Threshold Enforcement
matched_requirements.description: Transactions scoring above the configured fraud threshold shall be held for manual review, and cross-currency transactions shall be scored with the converted base-currency amount.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-014 identified in the change.

matched_requirements.title: Full and Partial Refund Processing
matched_requirements.description: The Refund Service shall support full and partial refunds against a captured payment, never exceeding the remaining refundable amount.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-007 identified in the change.

matched_requirements.title: Payment Validation Rules Engine
matched_requirements.description: The Payment Validator shall validate amount, currency code, merchant configuration and payment instrument before any authorisation call, returning a deterministic list of validation errors.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-004 identified in the change.

matched_requirements.title: Unsupported Currency Rejection
matched_requirements.description: Payment requests carrying a currency code outside the merchant's supported currency list shall be rejected with error UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY before funds are reserved.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-004 identified in the change.

matched_requirements.title: Multi Currency Payment Processing
matched_requirements.description: The platform shall accept payments in every enabled settlement currency, converting to the merchant settlement currency using the rate effective at authorisation time and storing both amounts.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-005 identified in the change.

matched_requirements.title: Payment Retry and Idempotency
matched_requirements.description: Repeated submissions of the same idempotency key shall never create a second authorisation; the original transaction result is replayed.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-003 identified in the change.

matched_requirements.title: Transaction Ledger Consistency
matched_requirements.description: Every captured payment and refund shall produce balanced double-entry ledger postings; the ledger shall reconcile to the transaction store daily.
matched_requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-015 identified in the change.

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.body: ECR-2026-004 (Introduce step-up authentication validation for high value payments) is a mixed change in the Security domain, scored 79/100 (CRITICAL). It touches REQ-1001 (Card Payment Authorization), REQ-1017 (Multi-Factor Authentication), REQ-1018 (Session Token Lifecycle). History is relevant here: BUG-180 (Fraud score computed on pre-conversion amount), BUG-201 (Payment validation allowed invalid currency codes), BUG-281 (Validator rejected valid amounts above 10,000). Decisions already recorded: Decision: UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY must be raised before funds are reserved, not after. Confirmed with treasury that no reservation may exist for a rejected currency. Open concern: BUG-201 was reopened twice because the fix only checked code length. Please add the ISO-4217 catalogue assertion to the regression pack, not just the merchant list check. Recommended regression: 73 of 150 tests (51.3% reduction), 0 P0 and 16 P1. Evidence is missing for: REQ-1001, REQ-1002, REQ-1004, REQ-1006.

sections.title: ECR Overview
sections.body: Introduce a new authentication validation step: payments above the configured high-value threshold must present a fresh multi-factor authentication assertion. The auth service issues a step-up token and the payment service validates the assertion before authorisation.

requirements.title: Card Payment Authorization
requirements.description: The Payment Service shall authorise card payments against the acquirer, capture an authorisation code and persist the transaction with its currency, amount and merchant reference.
requirements.reason: Explicitly linked to the ECR in the change record.

requirements.title: Multi-Factor Authentication
requirements.description: Sign-in from an unrecognised device and any high-value payment shall require a second authentication factor before the action completes.
requirements.reason: Explicitly linked to the ECR in the change record.

requirements.title: Session Token Lifecycle
requirements.description: Access tokens shall expire after 30 minutes of inactivity, be renewable with a refresh token and be revoked immediately on password change.
requirements.reason: Explicitly linked to the ECR in the change record.

requirements.title: Fraud Screening Threshold Enforcement
requirements.description: Transactions scoring above the configured fraud threshold shall be held for manual review, and cross-currency transactions shall be scored with the converted base-currency amount.
requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-014 identified in the change.

requirements.title: Full and Partial Refund Processing
requirements.description: The Refund Service shall support full and partial refunds against a captured payment, never exceeding the remaining refundable amount.
requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-007 identified in the change.

requirements.title: Payment Validation Rules Engine
requirements.description: The Payment Validator shall validate amount, currency code, merchant configuration and payment instrument before any authorisation call, returning a deterministic list of validation errors.
requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-004 identified in the change.

requirements.title: Unsupported Currency Rejection
requirements.description: Payment requests carrying a currency code outside the merchant's supported currency list shall be rejected with error UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY before funds are reserved.
requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-004 identified in the change.

requirements.title: Multi Currency Payment Processing
requirements.description: The platform shall accept payments in every enabled settlement currency, converting to the merchant settlement currency using the rate effective at authorisation time and storing both amounts.
requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-005 identified in the change.

requirements.title: Payment Retry and Idempotency
requirements.description: Repeated submissions of the same idempotency key shall never create a second authorisation; the original transaction result is replayed.
requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-003 identified in the change.

requirements.title: Transaction Ledger Consistency
requirements.description: Every captured payment and refund shall produce balanced double-entry ledger postings; the ledger shall reconcile to the transaction store daily.
requirements.reason: Traced through component CMP-015 identified in the change.
